Job Description – Technical Solutioning Specialist
Business Development & Product Commercialization
Leumas · Bengaluru

Leumas is looking for exceptional problem-solvers who are excited by the challenge of translating customer ideas into commercially successful products.
As a Technical Solutioning Specialist, you will operate at the intersection of Business Development, Product Development, Manufacturing, and Customer Success. You will work directly with customers to understand their requirements, collaborate with internal teams to evaluate feasibility, and drive projects from concept to commercialization.
This is a high-impact role designed for individuals who enjoy solving complex problems, working with multiple stakeholders, and building products that eventually reach the market.

About Leumas
Leumas is a Bangalore-based deep-tech manufacturing company building a software-defined production platform for healthcare manufacturing. Its proprietary, full-stack Manufacturing Operating System orchestrates the entire manufacturing lifecycle - from formulation logic and material flow to production execution, quality control, and traceability - enabling modular, reconfigurable factories that scale with demand.
Leumas addresses structural challenges in global supply chains, rigidity, long lead times, and capital intensive, step function scale - through a modular, distributed manufacturing architecture that enables faster deployment, higher asset utilization, and materially improved business outcomes across product life cycle Leumas supports two primary deployment models.
For enterprise customers, it enables dedicated manufacturing suites that provide high levels of supply chain control, compliance, and flexibility without the burden of traditional greenfield capex or non-resilient supply chains from traditional CDMOs. For healthcare innovators, the platform allows rapid configuration of production lines through software, enabling faster product launches, tighter quality control, and responsive scale-up or scale down.
Leumas’ production systems currently support more than a dozen finished formulations and consumer health formats, including semi-solids (ointments, gels, lotions), oral solid dosage
forms (tablets, capsules), and liquid formulations, with integrated QA and inspection capabilities.

The Role
As a Technical Solutioning Specialist, you will be responsible for bridging the gap between customer requirements and internal execution teams. You will engage with customers to understand their product vision, analyse technical and commercial feasibility, align stakeholders across functions, and ensure that development projects move seamlessly from requirement gathering to commercialization.
The role demands a combination of technical aptitude, structured thinking, stakeholder management, business understanding, and exceptional communication skills.

What You Will Own
1. Customer Discovery & Requirement Understanding
• Engage with prospective and existing customers to understand product requirements, business objectives, target consumer segments, product positioning, launch timelines, and commercial expectations.
• Conduct structured requirement-gathering discussions and convert customer inputs into actionable project briefs.
• Identify critical success factors, dependencies, assumptions, and project constraints.
2. Technical Solution Development
• Work closely with Product Development, Quality, Regulatory, Manufacturing, and Supply Chain teams to evaluate project feasibility.
• Understand formulation possibilities, ingredient constraints, packaging considerations, and manufacturing capabilities.
• Develop solution approaches that balance customer requirements, technical feasibility, regulatory requirements, and commercial viability.
• Recommend alternate approaches when customer expectations cannot be executed as proposed.
3. Customer-to-NPD Alignment
• Translate customer requirements into clearly defined technical deliverables for internal teams.
• Ensure complete alignment between customer expectations and product development activities.
• Maintain clarity on project scope, timelines, milestones, and deliverables throughout the development lifecycle.
• Drive resolution of ambiguities and ensure all stakeholders remain aligned.
4. Commercialization & Project Ownership
• Track projects from concept stage through development, validation, and commercialization.
• Monitor project progress and proactively identify bottlenecks.
• Coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure timely execution.
• Ensure customer commitments are translated into executable internal plans.
5. Technical Commercial Proposals
• Support preparation of customer proposals, technical presentations, and solution documents.
• Participate in customer meetings, project reviews, and technical discussions.
• Clearly communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Contribute to development of customer-specific solution recommendations.
6. Stakeholder Management
• Act as the primary coordination point between customers and internal teams.
• Facilitate discussions across Product Development, Quality, Regulatory, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Business Development functions.
• Ensure timely communication of project updates, decisions, risks, and dependencies.
• Escalate critical issues proactively and drive closure.
7. Innovation & Market Intelligence
• Track emerging trends, ingredients, dosage formats, packaging innovations, and market developments.
• Study competitive products and evolving customer requirements.
• Contribute ideas for new product opportunities and differentiated customer solutions.
• Support development of innovation-led customer engagements.
data.additional_details:
You're a Fit If
1. You hold a B.Tech or B.Sc degree in Engineering, Applied Sciences, Biotechnology, Food Technology, Chemical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Industrial
Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
2. You are excited by the idea of working at the intersection of technology, product development, manufacturing, and business.
3. You enjoy solving complex problems and are naturally curious about how products move from concept to commercialization.
4. You have the ability to understand customer requirements, ask insightful questions, and convert ambiguity into structured problem statements.
5. You are passionate about building products and interested in understanding how customer needs translate into technical solutions.
6. You possess strong communication skills and are comfortable interacting with customers, founders, product teams, and technical stakeholders.
7. You thrive in fast-paced environments where ownership, adaptability, and initiative are highly valued.
8. You are motivated by challenging problems and excited to work on projects that directly influence customer success and business growth.

How You Will Operate
1. You will think from first principles and approach problems with curiosity and structure.
2. You will act as the voice of the customer while maintaining technical and operational practicality.
3. You will proactively drive alignment across customers and internal stakeholders.
4. You will communicate clearly, concisely, and professionally.
5. You will take ownership of outcomes and ensure projects progress with speed and accountability.

Why Join
1. Opportunity to work at the intersection of Business Development, Product Development, Manufacturing, and Technology.
2. Exposure to end-to-end product commercialization across multiple healthcare and wellness categories.
3. Direct interaction with founders, customers, and cross-functional leadership teams.
4. Opportunity to influence product strategy, customer experience, and business growth from an early stage.
5. Accelerated learning environment designed for individuals who aspire to build careers in product, business, technology, and leadership.

Role Details
Eligibilty: B.Tech / B.S
Location: Bengaluru (On-site)
